description: This file defines the interface ISiloLifecycle within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It describes the observable lifecycle of a silo with properties indicating the highest completed start stage and the lowest completed stop stage.

classes.name: ISiloLifecycle
classes.description: An interface representing the lifecycle of a silo, allowing observation of lifecycle stages and participation in the lifecycle process.

methods.name: HighestCompletedStage
methods.description: Property indicating the highest lifecycle stage that has completed starting.

methods.name: LowestStoppedStage
methods.description: Property indicating the lowest lifecycle stage that has completed stopping.
